subject: RAISE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1197 (landed with PB1425, w1019a). RAISE { EXCEPTION exception-name-1 | identifier-1 }: identifier-1 takes the shared objectReference rule, which now carries every identifier format that can yield an object reference - a data-name, SELF, an inline invocation and a function-identifier (w1018d) and the object-view (this landing): `RAISE OU AS PB1425VA` raises the object and the class's USE AFTER EXCEPTION OBJECT declarative selects it (RAISED-OBJECT). NULL and SUPER stay 14.9.29.3 SR2's COBOL0848. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
